Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed WebSurfer to rely on a Discogs “master” entry that appears to be an 8-track sampler rather than the full Back to Mono box set, then repeatedly doubled down on that source. This over-reliance on an incomplete/incorrect edition and failure to adapt (e.g., by checking the full box-set listing on Wikipedia or liner notes) led to a misleading conclusion about the opening track and unnecessary looping, instead of resolving the tombstone clue and confirming the correct songwriter (Phil Spector) efficiently.
